selection_process: The DPSRU selection process may include:
Application screening Written examination Skill test Interview Document verification
A shorthand and typing skill test will be conducted for Personal Secretary and Personal Assistant. Candidates who qualify in the skill test may be called for an interview.
how_to_apply: Visit the DPSRU website at dpsru.edu.in.
Fill in the application form digitally. Manually written forms, except for the forwarding note, will not be considered.
Attach self-attested copies of the date-of-birth proof, educational certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates and other applicable documents.
Submit a separate application for each post if applying for more than one vacancy.
Write “Application for the post of ______” on the envelope.
Send the completed application to the Registrar, DPSRU, before the applicable extended deadline.
important_instructions: Advance copies must reach DPSRU by 25 September 2026. Applications sent through the proper channel must reach by 12 October 2026. Soft copies and applications sent by email will not be considered. Government, semi-government, PSU and autonomous-organisation employees must apply through the proper channel. Applicants should keep an active email address because recruitment communication will be sent by email. Only Delhi OBC candidates covered under the applicable GNCTD orders will receive OBC reservation and age-relaxation benefits. Selected deputation candidates will initially be appointed for one year, extendable according to university requirements and rules.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DPSRU Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the DPSRU website at dpsru.edu.in . Download the prescribed application form. Fill in the application form digitally. Manually written forms, except for the forwarding note, will not be considered. Attach self-attested copies of the date-of-birth proof, educational certificates, mark sheets, experience certificates and other applicable documents. Submit a separate application for each post if applying for more than one vacancy. Write “Application for the post of ______” on the envelope. Send the completed application to the Registrar, DPSRU, before the applicable extended deadline.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in DPSRU Recruitment 2026?
Q2. What is the last date for submitting an advance copy?
faq.answer: The extended deadline for submitting the advance copy is 25 September 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date for the proper-channel application?
faq.answer: The proper-channel copy must reach DPSRU by 12 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Which posts are included in the recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes Registrar, Controller of Finance, Section Officer, Assistant Registrar, Technical Assistant, Junior Assistant, Lab Assistant and several other non-teaching posts.

faq.question: Q5. What is the DPSRU application mode?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the prescribed application form in offline mode.

faq.question: Q6. Can candidates apply by email?
faq.answer: No. Soft copies and applications submitted through email will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. Is direct recruitment available?
faq.answer: Yes. Two Section Officer posts are advertised under direct recruitment. Most of the remaining posts are offered on deputation.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process?
faq.answer: The selection process may include a written test, skill test and/or interview, depending on the post.
